top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Orioles in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a hard-fought win against the Baltimore Orioles, coming out on top 6-5. Logan Gilbert led the Mariners' pitching effort with 6.0 innings pitched, striking out 5 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Rout Pirates 12-3**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a 9-run victory. Andy Pages led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Red Sox 4-3 in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Nick Martinez earning the win. Marcelo Mayer led the Red Sox offense with a 2-RBI performance, including a crucial double that plated two runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 10-4**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a 10-4 victory. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Transfer Brian Fitzpatrick to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have updated the status of LHP Brian Fitzpatrick, transferring him from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left elbow injury.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks have made a trade, sending RHP Taylor Rashi to the Minnesota Twins in exchange for cash.
